verdict.rationale: Auth0's B2B marketing page says enterprise clients can 'synchronize user directories via SCIM or Google Workspace', and the pricing page lists SCIM alongside enterprise connections. That confirms SCIM-based directory sync exists, but the evidence is marketing-level only and never covers group sync or deprovisioning behavior. Missing for 10: group sync, confirmation that IdP-side deprovisioning revokes app access or sessions, in-depth SCIM docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
